name: Philip
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament

points: Philip asks to be shown the Father, which makes no sense if Christ is his own Father and Philip is looking at him already.
That is why Isaiah 9 calls him the everlasting Father, and it is why the question Philip asked was not a confused one.

note.label: Escape Thankskilling : Oh God & My Lord
